meta.name: The Puppet Master Hunting the Ultimate Conman
meta.description:
This harrowing docuseries explores, a cruel conman masquerading as a British spy manipulates and steals from his victims, leaving ruined families in his wake.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 18 Jan 2022 · United Kingdom · Language: English · 42 min
Studio: RAW · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 3/3

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: They Vanished
videos.overview: In 1993, Robert convinces his college friends he's an MI5 agent.  Decades later, a man named David exerts an extreme level of control over a family.

videos.title: Chasing a Ghost
videos.overview: The father of an early victim raises the alarm with authorities about his daughter's safety.  Decades later, the police chase down a bizarre lead.

videos.title: Setting the Trap
videos.overview: As Robert continues to exploit and ruin lives, the authorities set a trap in London.  Meanwhile, in the present, Sandra's children hold out hope.
